Part 100 of the "JPG-set from the early internet when every megabyte mattered that after all these years still didn't have a lossless rip" CG series.

Animated WEBP: https://e-hentai.org/g/4231309/d7849b7eca/

...and with that season one comes to a close, having accomplished my goal of at least one set a day until we reach a hundred. That means it's time for a break. There's easily enough sets out there for another season but I can't say how long it'll be until I pick this project back up. Need to spend some time with my own collection now.
Two notable cancelled rips:
Tsu-bo-mi sadly looked just as dogshit re-ripped. Someone must've deepfried those CGs before the game was released.
Kanata no Mori. Couldn't rip, couldn't speedrun to capture CGs straight from the gallery. I'll keep looking but hopefully someone else will eventually figure it out.
